description: This file defines a React custom hook called useNotifications, which manages fetching, real-time updates, and interaction with a notifications table in a Supabase database. It includes logic for filtering notifications based on user targeting (user ID, email, roles), marking notifications as read, and adding new notifications.

methods.name: isTableMissingError(error)
methods.description: Checks if an error message indicates a missing table.

methods.name: toNotificationModel(r)
methods.description: Converts a database row into a notification object with standardized fields.

methods.name: matchesAudience(notif, user, roles = [])
methods.description: Determines if a notification should be visible to the current user based on targeting fields.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches recent notifications from the database and filters them based on audience.

methods.name: markRead
methods.description: Marks a specific notification as read by updating its status and timestamp.

methods.name: markAllRead
methods.description: Marks all visible notifications as read.

methods.name: addNotification
methods.description: Creates a new notification record in the database and optionally appends it to local state.
